faq.description: Everything you need to know about our privacy policies, kit access, and offline learning.

q1.question: Is learning progress and user data kept confidential?
q1.answer: Yes. Student profiles and progress tracking are encrypted and private, ensuring no sensitive personal information is ever publicly accessible.

q2.question: Does the app work without an active internet connection?
q2.answer: Absolutely. Modules can be downloaded when connected to Wi-Fi or cellular networks and accessed anytime offline.

q3.question: How can schools or community organizations request menstrual kits?
q3.answer: Registered partner schools and health facilitators can submit a kit request form directly through our portal or by contacting local field agents.

q4.question: Are the educational materials free to use?
q4.answer: Yes, 100% of our educational content, interactive modules, and digital resources are free for students and schools.
